model.name: evidence.evidenceForStep
model.description: The ONE shared evidence predicate: evidenceForStep(unit, step) -> boolean — has this checklist step's evidence actually landed (the real chain-edge: the chain reached a shipped Impl AND a two-keyed passing Test<->Impl.tests[] for that step)? BOTH statusNext (controller/prevention, refuses to advance past a step whose evidence is absent) AND checklist-chain-audit (backstop) CONSUME this single definition; the audit's existing inline chain-edge computation refactors to CALL this predicate and its inline copy is retired. Single-source so the two evidence-askers can never disagree (applies C4's own single-source law to the fix's internals).
